articles.description: TAIZ – SABA A woman was killed and five civilians, including an 8-year-old child, were injured on Friday in shelling and sniper attacks carried out by Houthi terrorist militias in several areas of Taiz governorate. Local sources reported that 51-year-old Fakiha Abduljalil Sufyan was killed by a Houthi sniper in al-Amd village, al-Aqroud, al-Misrakh district. The five injured civilians, including two minors, sustained gunshot and shrapnel wounds in various areas of al-Misrakh and Jabal Habashi districts. Some suffered injuries to the abdomen and limbs.
